items.headline: Use 'Recap the meeting so far' to catch up when late without disrupting the conversation
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot now supports natural language commands like 'Recap the meeting so far' to get instant summaries when joining late. The feature saves users from interrupting live meetings to ask what they missed. Organizations using AI assistants in daily work save an average of two hours per week per employee.

items.headline: EU Commission publishes Code of Practice on marking and labeling AI-generated content (10 June 2026)
items.summary: The European Commission published a Code of Practice on marking and labeling AI-generated content on 10 June 2026, ahead of the EU AI Act becoming fully applicable on 2 August 2026. The code establishes transparency standards for enterprises deploying generative AI. The EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and ISO/IEC 42001 are converging to define how organizations design, deploy, and monitor AI systems globally.
